settings._notes: dailyLimit = how many affirmations a visitor can reveal per day. visitNudgeAfter = after this many visits in one day, show a gentle take-a-break banner. Everyone sees the same first affirmation each day. type is 'affirmation' or 'suggestion'; area matches a wellness area (optional).

affirmations.text: My feelings are information, not instructions. I can notice them and still choose my next step.
I don't have to earn rest. I'm allowed to slow down today.
Progress isn't a straight line, and that's okay. I'm still moving.
I can hold a hard moment without letting it define my whole day.
Being gentle with myself is a strength, not a weakness.
I am more than my worst day.
It's okay to ask for help. Reaching out is part of taking care of myself.
Today I'll meet myself with the patience I'd give a good friend.
Try box breathing: in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4. Repeat four times.
Name three things you can see, two you can hear, and one you can feel right now.
My body has carried me through every hard day so far. I'll treat it kindly today.
Small movements count. A short walk is still a walk.
Drink a full glass of water before your next screen session.
Stand up, roll your shoulders back five times, and unclench your jaw.
Step outside for five minutes and let daylight hit your face.
Pick a bedtime tonight and set a gentle alarm 30 minutes before it to start winding down.
Eat one meal today away from any screen. Notice the taste.
I can return to what I value, no matter how far I've drifted.
There is meaning in ordinary moments, and I'm allowed to notice it.
I am part of something larger than today's worries.
Write down one thing you're grateful for that you usually take for granted.
Spend two quiet minutes doing nothing at all. Just breathe and notice.
Watch the sky for a few minutes today: sunrise, clouds, or stars.
My boundaries protect my relationships. Saying no can be an act of care.
I deserve connection, and I have something to offer others.
I can let people in a little at a time.
Send a short message to someone you've been meaning to check on.
In your next conversation, listen for one thing you didn't know about the other person.
Call someone instead of texting. Hearing a voice matters.
Curiosity is welcome here. I'm allowed to be a beginner.
My mind can learn new patterns. Every day is practice.
Read ten pages of a physical book today.
Learn one new word, fact, or skill and tell someone about it.
Notice a thought that keeps repeating. Write it down and ask: is this fully true?
I don't need to do everything today. I need to do the next right thing.
My worth is not measured by my productivity.
Done is better than perfect. I can start small.
Pick the one task that would make today feel successful, and do it first.
Work for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break away from the screen.
I can make my space a little kinder to me, one small change at a time.
Clear one surface: a nightstand, a desk corner, a kitchen counter.
Open a window for ten minutes and let fresh air in.
Put your phone in another room for the first hour after you wake up tomorrow.
Make your bed. It's a small win you can see all day.
I can look at my finances with curiosity instead of fear.
Small, steady choices add up. I don't have to fix everything at once.
Before buying something non-essential today, wait 24 hours and see if you still want it.
Check one account balance calmly, just to know where you stand.
Small kindnesses ripple further than I can see.
Do one kind thing for a stranger today, without needing them to notice.
Thank someone whose work usually goes unnoticed.
Showing up for myself today, in any small way, is enough.
I am allowed to begin again, as many times as I need.
Rest is part of the work, not a break from it.
I can do hard things, and I don't have to do them alone.
Today doesn't have to be perfect to be good.

breakReminders: That's your affirmations for today. The best next step is offline: go take a walk, stretch, or look out a window.
You've had today's wisdom. Now give your eyes and mind a rest from screens. New affirmations arrive tomorrow.
Time to put the phone down. Notice something real around you: a sound, a smell, the light.
Enough screen for now. Go do one kind thing for your body: water, a stretch, fresh air.
You're all set for today. Try living one of these affirmations instead of reading another.
visitNudges: You've stopped by quite a few times today. Maybe it's a good moment to step away from the screen for a while.
Checking in often today? That's okay. Consider a tech break: a walk, a call, or a few slow breaths.
This page will still be here tomorrow. Give yourself permission to log off for a bit.
